dashboard.projectTitle: Stress Concentration Analysis of a Plate with a Central Hole
dashboard.courseOutcome: CO1: Design components subjected to stress concentration by selecting appropriate materials and geometric modifications.
dashboard.programOutcomes: PO1, PO2, PO3, PO4, PO5, PO7, PO8, PO9, PO11

projectCharter.projectBackground: A flat steel plate containing a central circular hole is subjected to uniaxial tensile loading in a structural assembly. Although the plate has not failed yet, engineers suspect high local stress concentration around the hole may cause fatigue failure or premature yielding.
projectCharter.engineeringContext: As a Mechanical Design Engineer, management has tasked you to analyze the existing design, determine the net section stress, evaluate the theoretical stress concentration factor (Kt), calculate peak stress, verify the factor of safety, and recommend geometric or material improvements.
objectives: Identify critical geometric parameters and loading directions.
Formulate engineering assumptions for stress concentration analysis.
Calculate net section area and nominal tensile stress.
Determine d/W ratio and theoretical stress concentration factor (Kt).
Evaluate maximum localized stress and factor of safety.
Provide justified design modifications to lower stress concentration.
projectCharter.professionalResponsibility: Engineers must accurately account for stress concentration to prevent sudden brittle or fatigue failure in structural members.
projectCharter.safetyConsiderations: Inadequate factor of safety under peak localized stresses leads to localized yielding, micro-crack initiation, and sudden component failure.
projectCharter.acceptanceCriteria: Complete all 12 engineering activities with verified mathematical calculations and clear technical justifications.

project-charter.title: Project Charter

cards.title: Problem Scenario
cards.body: A flat steel plate with a central circular hole subjected to an axial tensile force P = 40 kN needs safety verification.

cards.title: Role & Assignment Scope
cards.body: You are a Mechanical Design Engineer in the Design Verification Dept tasked with determining maximum stress and proposing design modifications.

project-charter.acceptanceText: I have read and accepted the Project Charter.

engineering-context.title: Engineering Context

cards.title: Applications of Plates with Holes
cards.body: Plates with holes are widely used as structural links, gusset plates, pressure vessel walls, aircraft skin panels, and mounting brackets.

cards.title: Importance of Stress Concentration
cards.body: Geometric discontinuities (holes, notches, fillets) disrupt uniform stress flow lines, creating localized peak stresses much higher than nominal stress.

cards.title: Real-World Examples
cards.body: In 1954, De Havilland Comet commercial aircraft crashed due to fatigue crack initiation from square window corners acting as severe stress raisers.

engineering-context.acceptanceText: I understand the engineering context of stress concentration.

engineering-calculations.title: Engineering Calculations

fields.label: Net Width W_net = (W - d) in mm
Net Section Area A_net = (W - d) * t in mm²
Nominal Tensile Stress σ_nominal = P / A_net in MPa

engineering-calculations.expectedProcess: Calculate Net Width = 80 mm, Net Area = 800 mm², and Nominal Stress = 50 MPa.

stress-concentration.title: Stress Concentration
given: Standard Kt Equation for plate with central hole: Kt = 3.00 - 3.13*(d/W) + 3.66*(d/W)² - 1.53*(d/W)³
stress-concentration.expectedProcess: Determine d/W = 0.20 and theoretical stress concentration factor Kt ≈ 2.51.

fields.label: Maximum Stress σ_max = Kt * σ_nominal in MPa

material-selection.title: Material Selection
material-selection.prompt: Compare material options for the plate considering yield strength, toughness, and stress concentration sensitivity.

options.title: Mild Steel (Plain Carbon Steel)
options.note: Yield Strength Syt = 250 MPa, High Ductility

options.title: EN8 (Medium Carbon Steel)
options.note: Yield Strength Syt = 465 MPa, Medium Carbon

options.title: Stainless Steel (AISI 304)
options.note: Yield Strength Syt = 290 MPa, High Corrosion Resistance

options.title: Aluminium Alloy 6061-T6
options.note: Yield Strength Syt = 270 MPa, Low Density

factor-of-safety.title: Factor of Safety

fields.label: Factor of Safety FOS = Syt / σ_max

factor-of-safety.expectedProcess: Calculate FOS = 1.99. Conclude that current design is marginal under static load and unsafe under dynamic/fatigue loading.

engineering-decision.title: Engineering Decision
engineering-decision.prompt: Recommend design improvements to lower stress concentration and increase factor of safety.

options.label: Increase Plate Width (W)
options.title: Increase Plate Width (W)
options.note: Reduces d/W ratio and nominal stress.

options.label: Reduce Hole Diameter (d)
options.title: Reduce Hole Diameter (d)
options.note: Increases net section area and lowers d/W.

options.label: Increase Plate Thickness (t)
options.title: Increase Plate Thickness (t)
options.note: Directly reduces nominal stress without altering d/W.

options.label: Upgrade Material to EN8 Steel
options.title: Upgrade Material to EN8 Steel
options.note: Increases yield strength Syt to 465 MPa.

options.label: Introduce Auxiliary Relief Holes
options.title: Introduce Auxiliary Relief Holes
options.note: Smooths stress flow lines around central hole.
